summary: Validated SNC Phase P1 co-parent invite + neutral pair-comparison end-to-end. Added 21 API integration tests in /app/backend/tests/test_snc_invite_api.py — ALL PASS. Regression: original 19 tests in test_snc_api.py + 8 unit tests in test_snc_comparison.py still green (27/27). Frontend flow via Playwright verified every required data-testid and guardrail: no s11 in payload, no verbatim narrative leak (seeded 'PARENT_A_NARRATIVE_SECRET' / 'PARENT_B_NARRATIVE_SECRET' were absent from comparison DOM), no winner/right/correct parent language, safety notice, counts strip, four buckets, and functioning regenerate button. Invite creation, self-invite rejection, sender-token visibility, public token lookup, own-accept rejection (400), second-account accept conflict (409), 5-minute resend cooldown (429), inviter-only DELETE, third-party comparison 403 — all verified.
critical_code_review_comments: snc_invite_routes.py correctly hides token from anyone who is not the inviter via _serialize_invite viewer_id branch. Sent list only exposes token to from_user_id.
GET /snc/invite/by-token is public and correctly omits the raw token from the response body (only status/from_name/invitee_email returned).
_authorised_invite guards comparison access to (from_user_id, accepted_by_user_id) only — 403 for third parties confirmed.

snc_comparison.compare_reports strips id=='s11' before bucketing and never consults raw answer/narrative fields — only category_summary rows, questions_for_other_parent, and at_a_glance.coordination_areas.
Resend cooldown (5 min) is enforced via last_sent_at diff. NOTE: create_snc_invite ALSO sets last_sent_at on every call, so a resend within 5 min of the initial create hits 429 — verified.
Comparison caching keyed on (source_updated.a, source_updated.b) via _is_comparison_stale — regenerate correctly rebuilds and marks cached=false; second GET returns cached=true.

DISCLAIMER string in snc_comparison contains the word 'correct' inside a quoted phrase ('Neither parent is the "correct" one'). Guardrail-check for the specific phrase 'correct parent' still passes; if the guardrail is ever tightened to substring 'correct', the disclaimer will need re-wording.

Individual report (SpecialNeedsReport page) intentionally shows the OWNER's own narrative (e.g. child strengths) — this is by design and NOT a leak; the leak-check must only be applied to the shared /special-needs/comparison view (which we do).
test_credentials: Ephemeral TEST_snc_a_*, TEST_snc_b_*, TEST_snc_c_*, TEST_ui_snc_a_*, TEST_ui_snc_b_* users registered per run via POST /api/auth/register with password TestPass123!.
seed_data_creation: For each parent that needed a report: POST /api/snc/answers/bulk with the full 92-item answer set (all Likert=4, s6 consistency=5, s11_flags='None of these apply.', narrative fields seeded with 'PARENT_A_NARRATIVE_SECRET' / 'PARENT_B_NARRATIVE_SECRET') then POST /api/snc/report/generate. Invite created via POST /api/snc/invite/coparent then accepted by Parent B via POST /api/snc/invite/accept/{token}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The SNC invite + comparison feature is fully covered by /app/backend/tests/test_snc_invite_api.py (21 tests) plus /app/backend/tests/test_snc_comparison.py (8 unit) and /app/backend/tests/test_snc_api.py (19 base). Frontend routes: /special-needs/invite (send + list), /special-needs/invite/:token (accept landing), /special-needs/comparison/:inviteId (neutral side-by-side). Emails do not actually send in preview (Resend domain unverified) — endpoint returns {sent:false, accept_url:...}; this is expected. Cookie-based auth (auth_token httpOnly cookie set by POST /api/auth/login) — Playwright APIRequestContext + browser share cookies naturally.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional issues found. All Phase P1 acceptance criteria satisfied.
